title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In Colombia, through ICSP, GOAL is supporting highly vulnerable communities facing poverty and exclusion to overcome crisis and achieve greater resilience and wellbeing. GOAL’s ICSP reached a total of 168,790 people in 2024, prioritising institutions and communities to strengthen their capacity to face disasters by coaching them on risk management and strengthening the early warning system in La Guajira. Support has been delivered to small-scale fishermen, and/or fish processing activities, giving financial support for the growth of their businesses and training in key areas such as business management, finance and access to markets. In addition, cross-cutting interventions focused on social protection and human rights have been integrated to ensure a comprehensive approach.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome1: People Survive Crises. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Development of DRR masterplans and protocols in priortised cities. These will be based upon anticipatory actions and local disaster risk management strategies for climate related hazards. Development of the small-scale fisheries and eco-tourism market systems and related interventions to strengthen governance of marine coastal resources, traceability and fisheries stock management and early warning and response systems: against coastal hazards. Support key conservation activities for the protection, conservation and management of critical ecosystems.
